name: Ichijou Kurea
source:
A first-year of Kouryoukan Academy, a gloomy and reserved girl.
Due to her personality, Kurea doesn't care about communicating with people, and is shown to be only interested in music.
She is actually the identity of a famous net singer "Claire of Chained†Coffin". She rarely puts emotion into anything, except when she's singing.
translation:
A first-year of Kouryoukan Academy, a gloomy and reserved girl.
Due to her personality, Kurea doesn't care about communicating with people, and is shown to be only interested in music.
She is actually the identity of a famous net singer "Claire of Chained†Coffin". She rarely puts emotion into anything, except when she's singing.
